title: racket collision proxy, fitted to the visual mesh
kind: ENGINEERING_PROXY — NOT a manufacturer collision model

units.verified: the source USD declares metersPerUnit=1.0 and upAxis=Z (evidence/racket_usd_audit.json), and every dimension below is a coordinate read straight out of that stage - no 0.001/1000 factor is applied

root_frame.name: racket_root
root_frame.definition: +Z = handle butt -> head tip, +X = face normal, +Y = Z x X, origin = handle butt
root_frame.mesh_local_to_world: identity (verified for both meshes while fitting; a non-identity xform aborts the build)
root_frame.convention_note: the same racket_root frame as outputs/simulation/rebot_b601_rs/morph_one/p6_frames/frame_tree.json (node racket_root, edge 14 target)

segmentation_measured.method: quantiles/breakpoints read off the authored vertex rings of Obj_Racket_0; no dimension is taken from a datasheet

containment.meaning: every sampled visual surface point is inside the proxy union (or at most tolerance_m outside it); the proxy therefore cannot let the visual racket poke through a shuttle

bbox_volume_coverage.meaning: of the visual bounding-box volume, this fraction is solid proxy; the rest is the air around the handle/head that the visual bbox spans (the bbox of a racket is mostly air, so this number is low by nature)

solid_volume.meaning: both are ESTIMATES: the proxy is a union (overlapping primitives are counted twice) and the shell volume is a signed-tetrahedron sum over open low-poly shells

leak.meaning: how much air the proxy claims: the worst proxy-interior point is this far from the nearest visual triangle (largest at the top of the string-bed slabs, where the elliptical bed narrows inside a z-slab)

repair.pass: per-point nearest-primitive growth (radius / half-extent) until containment

accuracy.tolerance_source: CONTAINMENT_TOL_M in this tool = 0.001 m, chosen one decade below the smallest racket feature the proxy models (shaft radius)
accuracy.acceptance_rule: the build exits 0 only if within_tolerance_fraction == 1.0 after the repair loop; otherwise it exits 1 and this file must not be used as a collider

explicitly_not: a manufacturer / CAD collision model: the source is a low-poly Sketchfab visual (CC-BY-4.0) whose overall length is 682.7 mm versus 675 mm product / 680 mm BWF max
a physical-material model: no mass, inertia, friction or restitution is stated here
a racket MOUNT model: the handle->flange transform stays UNKNOWN (frame_tree.json edges 13/14) and no mount geometry is added by this proxy
a deformation model: the bed is modelled as a rigid solid membrane

unknown.what: the real racket's strung bed tension / deflection
unknown.missing_datum: no string-tension measurement in the repo

unknown.what: the collision behaviour of the actual physical racket
unknown.missing_datum: no contact experiment; the proxy has no material properties

unknown.what: the material of the frame (mass distribution)
unknown.missing_datum: the visual asset carries colour only
